_note: `declarationMap` without `declaration`/`composite` is a compiler-option error. It is attributed to the generated overlay tsconfig — the overlay is the root config the compiler is given — and the compiler then abandons the program without checking anything. Because diagnostics on our own overlay are filtered as structural noise, the run surfaced nothing and exited 0: a false-clean indistinguishable from a healthy check, hiding the real error in input.svelte. The run must fail loudly instead.
